name: Snap Inc. (SNAP)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. The shares trade about 2% above the Base value of $5.52. Reported free cash flow looks cheap, but stock compensation of about $1 billion a year takes it all back, and a 45% margin of safety puts the buy zone at $3.04 or below.
llms: Advertising and subscription platform behind Snapchat (493 million daily users, 971 million monthly users). Q2 2026 revenue rose 19% to $1.6 billion and free cash flow was $706 million over twelve months, but stock compensation of about $1.03 billion a year more than offsets it. Bear $3.44, Base $5.52, Bull $9.68. Verdict Hold at $5.65, maximum buy price $3.04.
